hypothesis: Source-preserved printed statements can qualify or contradict reported coordinates and native symbol candidates without silently changing the log or asserting a runtime revision.

sampling.procedure: Reproduce the 63-case R000 pool using the catalog whose selected_digest AND graph.identity_digest match scope: one mentioned tag with graph=true, nonempty frames/exceptions and a closing relation, sorted by sha256(repository + '#' + number). The first 24 match development; reserve the next four without inspecting their inputs. Verify selected commits against the frozen graph prefix.
sampling.catalog_boundary: Older similarly named audit-1399844 artifacts share the source digest but have a different graph digest and do not reproduce the frozen pool. They are not sampling inputs for this round.

pre_registered_controls.input: Audit every captured frame, including unresolved and external paths, without reading PR references or issue titles. Preserve original offsets, reported coordinates and native candidate identities.
pre_registered_controls.physical_statement: Use the line after the parsed frame header only when it retains the exact prefix preceding File. Remove that prefix and surrounding ASCII whitespace; do not rewrite quotes, comments, operators or source text. Repeated frame headers, traceback boundaries and empty rows are not source statements.
pre_registered_controls.escaped_statement: When the header is immediately followed by a backslash-newline separator, delimit the virtual line using the same exact backslash depth. Preserve source spans and raw statement escapes; do not globally decode the log or reinterpret Windows paths.
pre_registered_controls.coordinate: Compare the extracted literal with the exact Git line at the reported coordinate, independently of whether CBM found a symbol there.
pre_registered_controls.symbol_scope: Search identical stripped byte lines only inside complete native same-file, exact-case frame-name candidates. Retain every matching native node/line association. A unique candidate is not a proven runtime identity; never choose the nearest of several matches.
pre_registered_controls.file_scope_control: Report full-file literal-match counts and bounded positions separately from symbol-scoped associations. File evidence cannot invent a CBM symbol.
pre_registered_controls.effect: Measure observed source-coordinate agreement, contradictions, ambiguity and candidate availability. This round does not tune PR ranking or claim fix recall.

acceptance: Source log regions, frame-header spans and printed-statement spans reconstruct exact original slices.
Replay captured CBM decoding through case_probe.locate; verify every named candidate comes from the expected native query and snapshot identity.
Every emitted match has byte-exact Git line evidence within its declared file or native symbol scope. Counts and truncation cannot manufacture uniqueness.
Test physical/escaped framing, CRLF, Windows paths, omitted statements, repeated text, nested native scopes, invalid ranges, zero-line nodes, external frames and corrupted prefixes.
Freeze the tested alignment policy and code hashes before inspecting reserved inputs. Do not substitute failing reserved cases or retune on their results.
Verify native reserved queries, source alignment, deterministic replay, regressions, lint and cost before committing. Retrieval defaults remain unpromoted.

results.interpretation: Literal checks qualify native frame bindings rather than proving runtime identity. Development includes eleven unique native node/line associations at different coordinates and three literals absent from the selected files. The reserved sample confirms exact coordinates and preserves its one multi-position ambiguity; it does not independently demonstrate unique-coordinate recovery or better PR retrieval.

findings.finding: Four literal statements occur at different coordinates, including _init_multimodal_config outside the originally reported native method range. Two other frames have incompatible prefixes and two literal candidates contain damaged text absent from Git. Preserve these gaps; do not repair OCR-like text.

findings.name: start_load_kv
findings.finding: The reported coordinate is a different method definition; the exact printed call is uniquely inside the native same-name candidate. This supplies a candidate relation, not a silently corrected runtime location.

findings.name: run_method
findings.finding: The exact statement appears three times in the file but once inside the native same-name function. Other frames exhibit different offsets or a statement absent from the selected file, so a single global line shift is not justified.

The same-depth separator rule preserves and aligns five serialized statements without decoding their source contents. Reserved cases contain physical lines only; escaped framing has known-case and fixture coverage, not fresh-case coverage.

findings.name: generate
findings.finding: Two identical statements lie in one native function. Preserve both positions; uniqueness of the symbol and uniqueness of its source coordinate are different questions.

gates.development_independent_gate: Reconstruct every literal span from the original log prefix and byte-check every coordinate/match against independent git show commit:path output. Verify the canonical Git blob hash, source SHA-256, complete counts and bounded positions. See frozen_policy.independent_development_gate for counts.
gates.native_gate_boundary: For all reserved captured responses, compare native labels, files and ranges to Archive.load_rows. Independently enumerate exact-file, exact-name native nodes to verify complete per-frame candidate sets. This is an offline correctness check, not a replacement query implementation. Counts repeat shared nodes and files across frames/cases.
gates.replay_normalization: Remove only the top-level seconds field. Preserve every source span, coordinate, candidate identity, count, limit and input digest.
gates.test_fixture_correction: The first focused run exposed an empty next line classified as prefix_mismatch. Classify an empty ASCII-whitespace row as no_printed_statement before checking its prefix. Fix and pass all focused tests before the policy freeze and reserved inspection.

known_regression.boundary: Reverify existing baseline evidence and exact frame spans; this does not rerun its retrieval pipeline.

gates.acceptance: Accept source-preserved coordinate qualification and native candidate associations. No retrieval policy or runtime-version inference is promoted.

cost.boundary: Alignment costs include source validation and Git reads but reuse captured CBM responses. Native probe costs include sequential disposable projections, queries and evaluation-reference reads. Processes may overlap read-only verification or tests and the upstream writer remains active; these are not isolated end-to-end agent latency measurements. Missing objects, size limits, unusual bytes and output truncation are fixture coverage where absent from real inputs.

replay.digest_encoding: Remove top-level seconds, json.dumps with sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':') and default ASCII escaping; SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes.

limitations: One availability-selected repository and four new cases do not establish cross-repository generalization. The frame grammar is Python-specific even though repository vocabulary is not hard-coded.

A literal match concerns the selected Git snapshot, not the deployed runtime, exception causality, or a repair. A mismatching literal can reflect revision drift, source formatting, serialized escaping or damaged input.

Same-depth escaped separators are a conservative framing candidate, not a general serializer decoder. Source escapes are not decoded, so differently encoded but semantically equal statements may remain unmatched.

ASCII boundary whitespace is ignored; internal whitespace, quotes, comments and Unicode encodings are not normalized. Multiline source reconstruction and symlink dereferencing are outside this literal-blob comparison.

File-wide matches cannot manufacture CBM definitions. A unique node/line association is stronger than a whole-file match but is still not runtime identity; several positions can identify the same native node.

Native candidate-set parity on selected snapshots does not validate global graph semantics or resolve R004's nested-import coverage defect. External-library frames remain out of scope unless their source is separately available.

Full per-case artifacts are research evidence, not a finalized bounded agent-tool response. No fresh text index was built: the four new inputs must be excluded from corpus statistics before any future retrieval evaluation.

next.direction: Return to search: test explicit conjunctions over source-preserved diagnostic constraints, native symbol/file scope and changed-versus-context patch fields, using the existing evidence indexes rather than unrestricted token addition.
next.first_action: Inspect known diagnostic/patch pairs to choose a small repository-agnostic constraint vocabulary and a fixed equal-candidate-budget control. Separate literal matching, symbol identity and repair applicability; do not turn R011 coordinate candidates into assumed runtime locations.
next.validation: Treat all 28 inspected cases as development. Freeze a retrieval policy and source-thread exclusions before reserving later unseen cases. Continue to prefer native CBM capabilities and record any missing engine query instead of constructing a substitute code graph.
